### Day 70: 2 Samuel 19:14–30
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-70-2-samuel-19-1430.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 19:27
Points:
- Mephibosheth arrived to greet David in mourning clothes, showing he had genuinely grieved the king's exile.
- He explained how his servant Ziba had betrayed his disability and slandered him to David.
- David's compromise to divide the property functioned as a test of Mephibosheth's true heart.
- Mephibosheth demonstrated pure integrity by happily relinquishing the inheritance simply because the king returned safely.
- His loyalty illustrates how believers are called to love and honor Christ the King above all worldly possessions.
